description: Get the result of an ABAP Unit test run by its run_id, for a run that had not finished when it was started. Waits for it within a bound.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

run_id.description: Run id a unit test run answered.

name: GetUnitTestResult
